quest.title: Meteorites and Adventure
quest.description: Jack from the Adventurers' Guild seems to have some ideas on what to do about those fallen meteorites...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only I could go check it out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's up?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. Well, it's not like anything special happened...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Hmm. No, I suppose this is actually quite special...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Yes! You must have seen them too, right? They've been falling from the sky for a while now.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Thanks to the Anemo God's protection... or maybe just blind good luck, none of them have hit the city so far.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: But quite a few have landed outside the city, and they say that whoever touches one of those meteorites will fall into a deep sleep... a kind of slumber that no one can wake them up from.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Cyrus has already gathered and commissioned quite a few adventurers. Some were sent to inform those still out there in the wild to seek shelter in the city...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: The others were to help the Knights of Favonius ascertain the positions of the fallen meteorites...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: And perform search and rescue operations around those meteorites.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: As for me, Cyrus said that I'd best stay in the city and help to take care of those who've fallen unconscious.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Maybe it's because my skills aren't up to par yet... But if I'm always stuck with these small tasks, I'll never get the chance to become stronger.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: *sigh* Regardless, I have to do what I've been assigned to do, and do it well... Still, can I ask you for a favor, Traveler?

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: I'd like you to help me go out there and gather some information regarding those meteorites...

choices.text: What would you need information for?

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Cyrus always says that you should be fully prepared before starting any adventure.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: If I could persuade him that I understand the situation well enough, and that I've made the necessary preparations...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Maybe he might let me join the investigation teams.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: But I'm busy helping people here at the moment, so I can't go out to gather any information.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: So, please, Traveler! Help me go outside and investigate the situation. You don't have to go far, just the Whispering Woods will do.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: If you find anything, come back and tell me. Whether I can go out and investigate or not... it's all in your hands now!

choices.text: So you want to sneak out and...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: What? Sneak out and... No! Not at all!

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: I do want to go out and investigate, yes... But help is needed inside the city, too, and that's very important! I can't just drop my duties like that...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: But it's just that... Well, Cyrus always says that you should make full preparations before starting any adventure.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: If I could persuade him that I understand the situation well enough, and that I've made the necessary preparations...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Maybe he might let me join the investigation teams.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: But I'm busy helping people here at the moment, so I can't go out to gather any information.

choices.text: You mean the half-price anniversary promotion at Good Hunter?

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: What!? The Good Hunter's having a promotion today? How did I not hear about that?

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Uh, no, wait! That's not what I wanted to talk about...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: So, meteorites have been raining down from the sky lately. I'm sure you've seen them too.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Thanks to the Anemo God's protection... or maybe just blind good luck, none of them have hit the city so far.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Well, looks like I've shaken them off for now. Still, what on earth is going on here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you come to investigate the meteorites?

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Yes, I did. Took a commission from the Guild and all to investigate matters related to the meteorites.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: But monsters near the spots where meteorites have landed have starting acting up all of a sudden.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Their strength, movements, and a whole host of other things are totally abnormal, and there's more of them than you usually see, as well.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: I was discovered, and didn't dare stay in the area, and so I took a few lesser-tread paths to shake them off my trail.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: I have to report these abnormalities to Cyrus as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything else of note?

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Anything else? Well, if I had to say it, it's that quite a few scholars are refusing to return to the city.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: No matter how hard I tried to convince them, they insisted on continuing their research.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: There aren't enough of us adventurers out here either, so we can't simply send them reminders every few days...

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: This is such a headache...

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Well, Traveler, if there's nothing else, you should be seeking shelter in the city too. We haven't the time to be dallying out here.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: You're back. Did you discover anything?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It seems like the monsters nearby have become way more active, and they don't look the same either...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: *sigh* I wonder if I'll be able to convince Cyrus...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you want to join the outdoor investigation?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Well, um... I mean, you have to take part in important jobs to prove your worth, you know? That's what I think, at least...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But if you mess up...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Hey! I haven't done anything yet! Don't jinx me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The monsters seem to be somewhat abnormal.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Abnormal? Perhaps it's the influence of the meteorites, then... Still, I suspect that someone has reported this already.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Besides, I have trouble taking on normal monsters. As for these abnormal ones... the less said the better.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There aren't a lot of adventurers out there investigating...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Ugh. Now that you mention it, there weren't a lot of adventurers who took up this set of commissions...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: It's always the same few people coming and going. Cyrus has been quite concerned, as well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There are still some scholars who refuse to seek shelter in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Is that so... Well, they've never been the easiest to convince.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Alright, I understand the situation now. Please take these as thanks for helping me investigate.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Scholars who refuse to seek shelter, abnormal monsters, and a lack of available manpower...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Come on, Jack, think... There has to be some way to convince Cyrus...
